text: {"lessons":["I should not sell a winner just to lock in a satisfying gain while letting losing positions drift; each decision should reflect the stock’s outlook and my portfolio plan.","Selling at a large loss is painful, but avoiding that pain is not a strategy. I should reassess losers against clear risk limits rather than wait for my cost basis.","My account fell substantially despite holding and selling positions, so I should monitor total-portfolio risk and diversification—not judge each stock in isolation."]}
